key_insight: IMPACT combines inverter-level cloud dynamics with plant history and solar physics to improve probabilistic photovoltaic generation forecasts 10–110 minutes ahead.
engineering_relevance: More accurate, calibrated short-term PV forecasts could support grid balancing and storage dispatch under changing cloud conditions.
method: Encode plant history, inverter spatial dynamics, future solar geometry, and current weather in four branches fused by gated cross-attention.
Use learned graph attention and horizon-weighted cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down signals.
Learn corrections to smart persistence and calibrate forecast quantiles online with kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a forecast skill score of 0.2950, exceeding all 14 baselines and the next-best model by 0.099; ablations show every branch contributes positively.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish cross-site generalization, and deployment requires inverter-level telemetry and reliable online calibration.
paper_title: IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting
